criteria.name: Technical Background
criteria.text: Background in Mathematics, Computer Science, Statistics, Physics, Linguistics, or a related technical field

criteria.name: Business Understanding
criteria.text: Experience understanding business needs, customer requirements, or business problems

criteria.name: Data Analysis
criteria.text: Experience analyzing data to generate insights and support business decisions

criteria.name: Python and SQL
criteria.text: Experience using Python or SQL for data analysis

criteria.name: Data Visualization
criteria.text: Experience using Tableau, Power BI, or similar visualization tools

criteria.name: Presentation and Reporting
criteria.text: Experience presenting analytical results or creating reports and presentations

criteria.name: Communication
criteria.text: Experience communicating analytical results to stakeholders or non-technical audiences

criteria.name: Initiative and Problem Solving
criteria.text: Demonstrated initiative, problem solving, or ability to work through unfamiliar problems
